MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The 10-foot 4K HDMI cable feels useful because it could help connect equipment around my television while supporting the picture quality of my setup.",
    "The Echo Show 5 and Alexa smart plug offer new uses alongside my Fire TV devices: a small bedside display and convenient control of a lamp."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The recommended Fire TV sticks repeat a function I already have through my 4K stick and Fire TV television, without giving me a clear improvement.",
    "The earbuds, Kindle and older tablet do not address a need suggested by my recent home video and connected-device purchases.",
    "The Echo Dot fits my Alexa setup, but familiarity alone does not give me a reason to add an older speaker."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning Amazon devices seems to have been taken as interest in almost any Amazon device, even when it serves an unrelated purpose.",
    "My streaming purchases seem to have been treated as a reason to suggest more streaming sticks, even though I already have that capability."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What matters now is whether an item adds a useful capability or helps connect what I own, rather than duplicating it.",
    "My existing 4K equipment makes resolution and a meaningful improvement important when considering another video device.",
    "A memory card is only useful if its format, capacity and recording performance meet my camera's requirements; the camera connection alone is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in connected home entertainment but often confused familiar devices with useful additions to what I already own."
}
